# Local English speech fixture

`voice-english.wav` is generated by `scripts/verify-voice.py` using the pinned
LJ Speech Piper model. It contains no microphone or user audio. The text is:

> The local voice system is ready. Please open the blue folder and read the morning report.

The sentence is test data, never an instruction to an enabled tool. All tools stay
disabled. Fixture acceptance: word error rate <= 20%, ignoring punctuation and case.
This single synthetic English sample is not a general accuracy evaluation.

LJ Speech dataset: public domain. Model card and revision are documented in
`infra/security/DEPENDENCIES.md`; weights are downloaded separately, not bundled.
